title: चतुःपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 54 · Balarama watches the mace duel

summary.en: Balarama sits to watch as Duryodhana, in golden armour, and Bhima enter the field of the duel, like two lions. They exchange harsh words, and the gods and the armies look on.
summary.kn: ಬಲರಾಮ ನೋಡಲು ಕುಳಿತಾಗ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಕವಚದ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಮತ್ತು ಭೀಮ ಎರಡು ಸಿಂಹಗಳಂತೆ ದ್ವಂದ್ವರಂಗವನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕಠಿಣ ಮಾತುಗಳ ವಿನಿಮಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ದೇವತೆಗಳು, ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳು ನೋಡುತ್ತವೆ.
summary.hi: बलराम देखने बैठते हैं और स्वर्ण-कवचधारी दुर्योधन तथा भीम दो सिंहों की तरह द्वन्द्व-भूमि में उतरते हैं। वे कठोर शब्दों का आदान-प्रदान करते हैं और देवता तथा सेनाएँ देखते हैं।
summary.te: బలరాముడు చూడటానికి కూర్చోగా బంగారు కవచధారి దుర్యోధనుడు, భీముడు రెండు సింహాల్లా ద్వంద్వ రంగంలోకి ప్రవేశిస్తారు. కఠిన మాటలు మార్చుకుంటారు; దేవతలు, సేనలు చూస్తాయి.
summary.ta: பலராமன் பார்க்க அமர, பொற்கவசம் அணிந்த துரியோதனனும் பீமனும் இரு சிங்கங்கள் போல் போர்க்களத்தில் இறங்குகின்றனர். கடும் சொற்கள் பரிமாறப்பட, தேவரும் படைகளும் பார்க்கின்றனர்.
summary.ml: പൊൻകവചമണിഞ്ഞ ദുര്യോധനനും ഭീമനും രണ്ടു സിംഹങ്ങളെപ്പോലെ ഗദായുദ്ധത്തിന്റെ രംഗത്തേക്ക് കടക്കുമ്പോൾ ബലരാമൻ ഇരുന്ന് കാണുന്നു. അവർ കടുത്ത വാക്കുകൾ കൈമാറുന്നു; ദേവന്മാരും സേനകളും നോക്കിനിൽക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.54; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवं तदभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं जनमेजय ।
यत्र दुःखान्वितो राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥

meaning.en: So that tumultuous battle began, Janamejaya, and there the grieving king Dhritarashtra said this.

verses.text:
रामं संनिहितं दृष्ट्वा गदायुद्ध उपस्थिते ।
मम पुत्रः कथं भीमं प्रत्ययुध्यत संजय ॥

meaning.en: "Sanjaya, when Rama was present and the mace duel was at hand, how did my son fight Bhima?"

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
रामसांनिध्यमासाद्य पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव ।
युद्धकामो महाबाहुः समहृष्यत वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: On finding Rama present, your son Duryodhana, the mighty-armed and powerful, eager for battle, was filled with joy.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा लाङ्गलिनं राजा प्रत्युत्थाय च भारत ।
प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो युधिष्ठिरमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the plough-bearer, the king rose, O Bharata, and in great delight said to Yudhishthira:

verses.text:
समन्तपञ्चकं क्षिप्रमितो याम विशां पते ।
प्रथितोत्तरवेदी सा देवलोके प्रजापतेः ॥

meaning.en: "Lord of men, let us go quickly from here to Samantapanchaka, famed in the world of the gods as Prajapati's northern altar."

verses.text:
तस्मिन्महापुण्यतमे त्रैलोक्यस्य सनातने ।
संग्रामे निधनं प्राप्य ध्रुवं स्वर्गो भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "If one meets death in battle in that most holy, eternal place of the three worlds, heaven is certain."

verses.text:
तथेत्युक्त्वा महाराज कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
समन्तपञ्चकं वीरः प्रायादभिमुखः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it," O great king, the hero Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, set out for Samantapanchaka.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम् ।
पद्भ्याममर्षाद्द्युतिमानगच्छत्पाण्डवैः सह ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, radiant, took his great mace and in anger went on foot with the Pandavas.

verses.text:
तथा यान्तं गदाहस्तं वर्मणा चापि दंशितम् ।
अन्तरिक्षगता देवाः साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन् ।
वातिकाश्च नरा येऽत्र दृष्ट्वा ते हर्षमागताः ॥

meaning.en: As he walked, mace in hand and armoured, the gods in the sky praised him, "Well done, well done!"; and the Vatika men there were delighted at the sight.

verses.text:
स पाण्डवैः परिवृतः कुरुराजस्तवात्मजः ।
मत्तस्येव गजेन्द्रस्य गतिमास्थाय सोऽव्रजत् ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by the Pandavas, your son the Kuru king went with the gait of a rutting lord of elephants.

verses.text:
ततः शङ्खनिनादेन भेरीणां च महास्वनैः ।
सिंहनादैश्च शूराणां दिशः सर्वाः प्रपूरिताः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the directions were filled with the sound of conches, the great noise of drums, and the lion-roars of the heroes.

verses.text:
प्रतीच्यभिमुखं देशं यथोद्दिष्टं सुतेन ते ।
गत्वा च तैः परिक्षिप्तं समन्तात्सर्वतोदिशम् ॥

meaning.en: They went to the place your son had indicated, facing west, and spread out on all sides around it.

verses.text:
दक्षिणेन सरस्वत्याः स्वयनं तीर्थमुत्तमम् ।
तस्मिन्देशे त्वनिरिणे तत्र युद्धमरोचयन् ॥

meaning.en: South of the Sarasvati lay the excellent ford Svayana; on that barren spot they chose to fight.

verses.text:
ततो भीमो महाकोटिं गदां गृह्याथ वर्मभृत् ।
बिभ्रद्रूपं महाराज सदृशं हि गरुत्मतः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima, armoured, took up his mace with its great tip, O great king, bearing a form like that of Garuda.

verses.text:
अवबद्धशिरस्त्राणः संख्ये काञ्चनवर्मभृत् ।
रराज राजन्पुत्रस्ते काञ्चनः शैलराडिव ॥

meaning.en: Your son, with his helmet bound on and wearing golden armour in battle, shone, O king, like a golden king of mountains.

verses.text:
वर्मभ्यां संवृतौ वीरौ भीमदुर्योधनावुभौ ।
संयुगे च प्रकाशेते संरब्धाविव कुञ्जरौ ॥

meaning.en: Both heroes, Bhima and Duryodhana, wrapped in armour, shone in battle like two furious elephants.

verses.text:
रणमण्डलमध्यस्थौ भ्रातरौ तौ नरर्षभौ ।
अशोभेतां महाराज चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two brothers, bulls among men, standing in the middle of the arena, shone, O great king, like the moon and sun risen together.

verses.text:
तावन्योन्यं निरीक्षेतां क्रुद्धाविव महाद्विपौ ।
दहन्तौ लोचनै राजन्परस्परवधैषिणौ ॥

meaning.en: They stared at each other like two angry great elephants, burning each other with their eyes, each wishing to kill the other.

verses.text:
संप्रहृष्टमना राजन्गदामादाय कौरवः ।
सृक्किणी संलिहन्राजन्क्रोधरक्तेक्षणः श्वसन् ॥

meaning.en: The Kaurava, with delighted mind, took up his mace, licking the corners of his mouth, breathing hard, his eyes red with anger.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा गदामादाय वीर्यवान् ।
भीमसेनमभिप्रेक्ष्य गजो गजमिवाह्वयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty King Duryodhana, mace in hand, looked at Bhimasena and challenged him as one elephant challenges another.

verses.text:
अद्रिसारमयीं भीमस्तथैवादाय वीर्यवान् ।
आह्वयामास नृपतिं सिंहः सिंहं यथा वने ॥

meaning.en: Mighty Bhima likewise took up his mace made of mountain-iron and challenged the king as a lion challenges a lion in the forest.

verses.text:
तावुद्यतगदापाणी दुर्योधनवृकोदरौ ।
संयुगे स्म प्रकाशेते गिरी सशिखराविव ॥

meaning.en: With maces raised in their hands, Duryodhana and Vrikodara shone in battle like two mountains with their peaks.

verses.text:
तावुभावभिसंक्रुद्धावुभौ भीमपराक्रमौ ।
उभौ शिष्यौ गदायुद्धे रौहिणेयस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: Both were furious, both of terrible might, both pupils of the wise son of Rohini in mace fighting.

verses.text:
उभौ सदृशकर्माणौ यमवासवयोरिव ।
तथा सदृशकर्माणौ वरुणस्य महाबलौ ॥

meaning.en: Both did deeds alike, like Yama and Indra, and like two of equal deeds of Varuna.

verses.text:
वासुदेवस्य रामस्य तथा वैश्रवणस्य च ।
सदृशौ तौ महाराज मधुकैटभयोर्युधि ॥

meaning.en: Those two, O great king, were alike in battle like Vasudeva and Rama, and like Kubera, and like Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.text:
उभौ सदृशकर्माणौ रणे सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः ।
तथैव कालस्य समौ मृत्योश्चैव परंतपौ ॥

meaning.en: Those scorchers of foes were alike in deeds in battle like Sunda and Upasunda, and equal to Time and Death.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यमभिधावन्तौ मत्ताविव महाद्विपौ ।
वाशितासंगमे दृप्तौ शरदीव मदोत्कटौ ॥

meaning.en: They rushed at each other like two rutting great elephants, proud like two in autumn musk-frenzy at meeting a female elephant.

verses.text:
मत्ताविव जिगीषन्तौ मातङ्गौ भरतर्षभौ ।
उभौ क्रोधविषं दीप्तं वमन्तावुरगाविव ॥

meaning.en: Those two best of Bharatas, like two elephants eager to win, both spewed the blazing poison of anger like two snakes.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धौ प्रेक्षमाणावरिंदमौ ।
उभौ भरतशार्दूलौ विक्रमेण समन्वितौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two subduers of enemies, furious at each other and glaring, two tigers of the Bharatas, were full of prowess.

verses.text:
सिंहाविव दुराधर्षौ गदायुद्धे परंतपौ ।
नखदंष्ट्रायुधौ वीरौ व्याघ्राविव दुरुत्सहौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two scorchers of foes in the mace fight were unassailable like lions, and hard to bear like tigers armed with claws and fangs.

verses.text:
प्रजासंहरणे क्षुब्धौ समुद्राविव दुस्तरौ ।
लोहिताङ्गाविव क्रुद्धौ प्रतपन्तौ महारथौ ॥

meaning.en: They were agitated like two oceans at the destruction of creatures, hard to cross, and, angry like two red planets, those great chariot-warriors blazed.

verses.text:
रश्मिमन्तौ महात्मानौ दीप्तिमन्तौ महाबलौ ।
ददृशाते कुरुश्रेष्ठौ कालसूर्याविवोदितौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two great-souled, mighty best of Kurus, radiant and gleaming, looked like Death and the sun risen together.

verses.text:
व्याघ्राविव सुसंरब्धौ गर्जन्ताविव तोयदौ ।
जहृषाते महाबाहू सिंहौ केसरिणाविव ॥

meaning.en: Greatly enraged like two tigers, roaring like two rain clouds, those two mighty-armed men rejoiced like two maned lions.

verses.text:
गजाविव सुसंरब्धौ ज्वलिताविव पावकौ ।
ददृशुस्तौ महात्मानौ सशृङ्गाविव पर्वतौ ॥

meaning.en: Furious like two elephants, blazing like two fires, those two great-souled men looked like two mountains with peaks.

verses.text:
रोषात्प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठौ निरीक्षन्तौ परस्परम् ।
तौ समेतौ महात्मानौ गदाहस्तौ नरोत्तमौ ॥

meaning.en: With lips quivering in rage, glaring at each other, those two best of men, mace in hand, came together.

verses.text:
उभौ परमसंहृष्टावुभौ परमसंमतौ ।
सदश्वाविव हेषन्तौ बृंहन्ताविव कुञ्जरौ ॥

meaning.en: Both highly delighted, both highly honoured, they neighed like two fine horses and trumpeted like two elephants.

verses.text:
वृषभाविव गर्जन्तौ दुर्योधनवृकोदरौ ।
दैत्याविव बलोन्मत्तौ रेजतुस्तौ नरोत्तमौ ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana and Vrikodara, bellowing like two bulls, shone like two Daitya heroes drunk with strength, those best of men.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजन्निदमाह युधिष्ठिरम् ।
सृञ्जयैः सह तिष्ठन्तं तपन्तमिव भास्करम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, Duryodhana said this to Yudhishthira, who stood with the Srinjayas like the blazing sun.

verses.text:
इदं व्यवसितं युद्धं मम भीमस्य चोभयोः ।
उपोपविष्टाः पश्यध्वं विमर्दं नृपसत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: "This fight between me and Bhima has been decided; sit down nearby and watch our clash, best of kings."

verses.text:
ततः समुपविष्टं तत्सुमहद्राजमण्डलम् ।
विराजमानं ददृशे दिवीवादित्यमण्डलम् ॥

meaning.en: Then that great circle of kings sat down and looked like the sun's disc in the sky.

verses.text:
तेषां मध्ये महाबाहुः श्रीमान्केशवपूर्वजः ।
उपविष्टो महाराज पूज्यमानः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: In their midst sat the mighty-armed, glorious elder brother of Keshava, O great king, honoured on all sides.

verses.text:
शुशुभे राजमध्यस्थो नीलवासाः सितप्रभः ।
नक्षत्रैरिव संपूर्णो वृतो निशि निशाकरः ॥

meaning.en: Seated among the kings, in blue garments and white in splendour, he shone like the moon at night surrounded by full stars.

verses.text:
तौ तथा तु महाराज गदाहस्तौ दुरासदौ ।
अन्योन्यं वाग्भिरुग्राभिस्तक्षमाणौ व्यवस्थितौ ॥

meaning.en: O great king, those two hard-to-face men stood, mace in hand, scraping each other with fierce words.

verses.text:
अप्रियाणि ततोऽन्योन्यमुक्त्वा तौ कुरुपुंगवौ ।
उदीक्षन्तौ स्थितौ वीरौ वृत्रशक्राविवाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Having spoken unkind words to each other, those two bulls of the Kurus stood gazing at each other like Vritra and Indra in battle.
